gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, terminals cut open so counters flow outward. Zalando Sans Expanded is the quieter one, a sparse wide-gapped row whose c tips never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiq: One-nib swagger from Gabarito, with terminals cut open so the counters flow outward and the look stays distinctive. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique, sans-serif, matches every t crossbar to its stem.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Nib-drawn swagger: Gabarito cuts its terminals wide open up top. Zen Kaku Gothic New then settles into sans-serif text with open-mouthed curves and no hairlines or swells, so the heading gets all the drama.
gen-gf-gabarito-zilla-slab: Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, its terminals cut open so counters flow outward. And Zilla Slab reads sturdy and technical over many lines, with a broad opening on every bowl-ended curve.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-chillax: Wide-set and commanding, Goldman has round forms that read like open parentheses. And Chillax loosens things with casual, spaghetti-like sans lines and pen-lifted curves that leave every loop unfinished.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-roundo: Commanding, Goldman spreads wide letters with generous clearance and a lowercase that towers over Roundo's moderate one. Roundo, sans-serif, keeps text easygoing: no hairlines, every small counter unclogged.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans keeps vertical and horizontal strokes identical in weight, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Goldman takes the loud part, widely set and commanding, with a lowercase that stands taller.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-synonym: Widely set letters with generous clearance give Goldman its commanding stance, plus round forms that read like open parentheses. Synonym is the dependable sans, a ruler-drawn line of constant ink.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-aclonica: Aclonica reads deep in the midsection, a long stretched-out line of widely spaced letters with a thickness shift felt more than seen. Goldman's wide, commanding letters carry the loud part up top.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-allerta: Wide, loud, commanding: Goldman sets round forms like open parentheses, with generous clearance between every single letter. Allerta is the sans-serif counterweight, loose in its tracking and prominent in x-height.
